about: Stratford is in Perth County, southwestern Ontario, on the Avon River. It is Canada’s principal classical-theatre city: the Stratford Festival fills purpose-built theatres each season and draws visitors to a walkable downtown of swans, river gardens, and brick shops. It is not Stratford, Prince Edward Island. About 33,000 people live in Stratford.
